map.以大衍之数五十起卦步骤: Casting steps using "the Great Expansion number fifty"
map.古法“大衍之数五十，其用四十有九”：分二、挂一、揲四、归奇为一易，三易（三变）成: The ancient method 'the Great Expansion number is fifty, its use forty-nine': divide into two, set aside one, count by fours, and group the remainder as one change; three changes make one line (remainders 36/32/28/24 correspond to old yang 9 / young yin 8 / young yang 7 / old yin 6, with 36 and 24 as moving lines). Repeating three changes x six lines yields six lines; old yang (9) becomes yin, old yin (6) becomes yang, giving the primary and changed hexagrams. The tool simulates this process with equal probability and is a traditional-culture entertainment reference.
